assumptions: Exact unscreened traversal; jet bounds ignore density-coefficient zeros. Generic old model applies only if no shell derivative lease is used. No FLOP interpretation.

quadratic_provider_work.definition: W(X) denotes one unscreened quadratic derivative consumer on density X, including shell primitive/component reuse and any exact zero-weight skips.
quadratic_provider_work.canonical: sum over unique Cartesian ERI orbits of derivative work for u-1 distinct atom centers, weighted directly by P_ab*D_cd - P_ac*D_bd/2
quadratic_provider_work.equal_pass_model_status: Derived only if the two schedules have equal per-pass cost. Not a measured shell work reduction or FLOP ratio.
quadratic_provider_work.capacity_note: Reuses combined N*N host matrix after each consumer drains; retained three-pass complete numeric bound covers both schedules.

screened_z_work.definitions: C(tau) is one geometry-only masked J/K action; ns/nc are measured provisional/corrective action counts. Canonical traversal count is unchanged by masking; evaluated ERIs can decrease. Extra audit/correction can outweigh that saving.

shell_work_note: Only pass counts are measured for shell derivatives (3 versus 2). Per-pass primitive/component work is not counted; no 3*N^4 claim.
